Smoke public_val_bpb more than 0.005 above the same-host control smoke (1.165855 trn21 / 1.165604 trn22)

Full-run step count differing from the same-host control by more than 3% (>62 steps): the comparison would be confounded by a throughput term this change is not supposed to have; report CONFOUNDED, not a quality verdict
Compile or startup failure attributable to the flag (e.g. Dynamo guard failure from a Python float reaching a compiled region)

research/experiment-protocol.md §5: quality comparisons require comparable step counts; this proposal is designed to satisfy that by construction
expected_effect: Lower val_bpb by 0.001 to 0.003 at a matched step count (expected 2060-2085 steps, within 1% of the 2071/2076 controls); i.e. candidate <= 1.0047 vs same-host control 1.005734 (trn21) or 1.005967 (trn22). A result within +/-0.0005 of the control at matched steps is a null; worse than +0.001 is a negative and closes the axis at these defaults.
hypothesis: Annealing the AdamW first-moment coefficient (beta1) multiplicatively across the LR warmdown (Recursive's 'Demon' schedule: a group whose initial beta1 is 0.8 lands at 0.55 at progress 1.0; the 0.9 scalar/gate groups shrink proportionally; the rmsprop n-gram tables are excluded by kind) lets the embedding-family updates (wte, lm_head, value embeddings) and the gate/scalar updates track the sharply decaying LR in the cooldown instead of averaging over a stale momentum window -- the same rationale train.py already adopted for Muon (MUON_MOMENTUM_COOLDOWN_FRAC 0.045 -> MUON_MOMENTUM_FINAL 0.85, part of the confirmed T0.4 stack). Because the change adds no tensors, ops or parameters and routes the per-step value as a device scalar, the throughput term is expected to be exactly zero, so the run should land within a few steps of the 2071/2076 controls and yield a clean, non-confounded per-step-quality comparison -- exactly the kind of comparison the recent throughput-shifting norm-boundary runs could not deliver.
single_causal_change: Pass --demon-beta1 only (DEMON_BETA1 True with its in-source defaults: DEMON_BETA1_FINAL 0.55, DEMON_BETA1_REF 0.8, DEMON_BETA1_START_FRAC -1.0 i.e. anneal begins where the LR warmdown begins at 1 - WARMDOWN_RATIO). Every other option stays at the 9a4caa7b defaults used by the two pinned controls: identical launch shape (NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2, torchrun --nproc_per_node=4, --num-steps 5000 --max-train-seconds 1800 --seed 42, NEURON_CC_FLAGS='--optlevel=1'). No precision flag (--bf16-sdpa-input, --bf16-norm-output), no kernel flag (--nki-*, --compile-*), no other optimizer switch (--cautious-wd, --wd-decay-to-zero, --muon-lr-fp32, --tensor-lr-scalars, --adam-every-n-lr-comp, --ngram-ve-opt/-lr/-beta2), no architecture switch, no data/eval change. The AdamW beta1 anneal is the sole causal option.
